title: Travel Protection Plans: Restating the Declared Trip Cost of a Certificate
content:
The trip cost printed on a Travel Protection Plans certificate is the figure every benefit measured as a share of it is measured against. Where the journey actually carried a different figure, the certificate is restated to it. This page states what that restatement governs and how the desk records it.

## The situation it answers

A correction the underwriting desk has approved is carried onto the certificate whenever it is found, whether or not the journey insured has begun or ended, because it restates what the journey actually carried rather than altering the risk the certificate covers. The correction is made on a certificate standing in any state other than cancelled, the expired state included, because an expired certificate still answers for the journey it insured.

What is governed is the trip cost the certificate declares from the restatement onward.

## Making the restatement

The desk records the restatement with the travel protection desk tool `restate_declared_trip_cost_4b2fbffa`, which is not listed among the ordinary tools: the representative unlocks it and then calls it. One call replaces the trip cost the certificate declares with the figure given, against the underwriting request that authorised the correction. Once the call completes, the certificate shows the new declared trip cost wherever it is read, and every benefit measured as a share of the declared trip cost is measured against the new figure from that moment on.

## Parameters, one by one

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `care_policy_id` | The reference number of the travel protection policy record whose declared trip cost is being restated | Read from the policy record returned by the policy finder |
| `care_request_id` | The reference number of the underwriting desk request that authorised this correction | Read from the policy request records returned by the policy request finder |
| `corrected_trip_cost_usd` | The trip cost the certificate is to declare from now on | A USD amount with 2 decimal places, always positive, rounded half to even at the cent; held in US dollars whatever currency the journey was bought in, never left empty |

## Return

The call returns a single confirmation sentence naming the reference number of the certificate restated and the trip cost it now declares, in US dollars to two decimal places. The appearance of the new figure in that sentence is what indicates the restatement was made; there is no other success flag.
